The proof invokes condition a), refers to v as algebraic, chooses a realizing Z prime, and subtracts its pullback. The content of a) is not on this page and was not imported.

check_events.outcome: Conditional linear-map check actually performed: write A for the map denoted i in (iv)Z, V for v and T for the correspondence action. Assume AV acts as identity on Im A, as the local proof invokes, and T takes values in Im A. For every h, AVT(h)=T(h), hence (T-AVT)(h)=0. This verifies only the subtraction step under these explicit assumptions and compatible realization; it does not verify unavailable condition a), algebraicity of a chosen realizing cycle, or the motivic parenthesis.

Symbolic calculation actually performed, no formal certificate: assuming evaluation at each t commutes with the pullback P=(i x id_C)^*, set Zdouble=Z-P(Zprime). Then [Zdouble(t_1)-Zdouble(t_o)] = [Z(t_1)-Z(t_o)] - i^*[Zprime(t_1)-Zprime(t_o)]. Rearrangement gives the printed a-prime equality. This checks the additive identity only, conditional on evaluation/pullback compatibility and on a consistently chosen second parameter; it proves no existence claim.
